answer: Seats stay with people who can pay once, not farms that must pay a hundred times. The manifest lists a name once it holds Millbound mill keeper grain charter, and a charter mill keepers file after mill checks is the entry the clerk looks for. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. Before the stamp comes $14 per docket, and 210 dockets before the first reward is released, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. One yarrow, one entry. The clerk notes ridge. The tally keeps basalt.
